reason: My bookkeeper already collects the receipts every month and sorts them out, so I don't see what I'd be paying $19 for. Most of what I spend on the scooters is cash to mechanics anyway, and half of that has no receipt at all.
objection: It's $19 a month for something my admin already does, and I'd still be paying the bookkeeper either way.
would_change_my_mind: If my bookkeeper said it would cut her monthly fee or save her real hours, or if I found out mechanics were double-charging me on repairs.
